_why: One name per idea, for the half of the API that is behaviour. lint:vocab holds the shared props to one set of VALUES and lint:api holds every prop name to one TYPE; neither stops a part from inventing a twenty-third word for a thing the system already names. On 2026-09-02 this catalogue published 32 callback names for about eight ideas, and writing one specimen against them means guessing. The canonical list is deliberately short: a name that is not on it is argued into this file, with what it means, before it is written at a call site.

canonical.onChange: The value this part owns became a different value. The argument is the new value, never an event.
canonical.onSelect: One of several offered things was chosen. The argument names what was chosen.
canonical.onOpenChange: A layer this part owns opened or closed. The argument is the new open state, so one name covers both directions and a controlled caller needs no second prop.
canonical.onDismiss: The person asked to be rid of it — Escape, the backdrop, the close control. Distinct from onOpenChange because a dismissal is a request that a caller may refuse.
canonical.onSubmit: A form was sent. The argument is what was collected.
canonical.onAction: A named action on this part was invoked. The argument says which one, so a part with five actions does not publish five callbacks.

exceptions._why: Every callback this catalogue published on 2026-09-02 that is not one of the six, with the name it reads as. These are recorded, not renamed: a rename is a breaking change to a published API and belongs in a version, not in the commit that starts measuring. config/api-debt.json freezes which parts carry each one, so an exception cannot spread while it waits.

onOpen.why: half of an open state, published as its own prop; the other half is onClose

onClose.why: the other half; a controlled layer then needs two props to say one thing

onNavOpen.why: the same pair again, prefixed with the thing it opens

onNavClose.why: the same pair again, prefixed with the thing it opens

onDetailClose.why: the same pair again, prefixed with the thing it opens

onCancel.why: a dismissal wearing the name of the button that caused it

onClear.why: clearing is a value becoming empty, which onChange already carries

onFiles.why: named after the payload rather than the idea; the value happens to be files

onMonthChange.why: a second value on a part that already publishes onChange — the shape of a compound that was not taken apart

onSortChange.why: a second value on a part that already publishes onChange

onCellChange.why: a second value on a part that already publishes onChange

onDensityChange.why: a second value on a part that already publishes onChange

onCollapsedChange.why: a second value on a part that already publishes onChange

onExpandedChange.why: a second value on a part that already publishes onChange

onStep.why: a step was chosen out of several

onStepClick.why: a step was chosen out of several, named after the input device

onBack.why: one named action out of a fixed set

onNext.why: one named action out of a fixed set

onSave.why: one named action out of a fixed set

onSend.why: one named action out of a fixed set

onStop.why: one named action out of a fixed set

onAbort.why: one named action out of a fixed set, and the second word for stopping

onReset.why: one named action out of a fixed set

onRemove.why: one named action out of a fixed set

onMove.why: one named action out of a fixed set

onLoad.why: one named action out of a fixed set

onDislike.why: one named action out of a fixed set

onClick.why: the DOM's name for an input device, published as this system's name for an intention
